sessionMemorySaved: Saved on this computer. Restart to continue this session.
sessionMemoryRecovered: Session restored. Previous speech and actions will not replay.
sessionMemoryDisabled: This session stays in memory only. It will not survive a restart.
sessionMemoryError: Session save failed. Chat still works, but new records can be lost on restart. Check local storage.
sessionMemoryScope: The current character uses {turns} delivered turns (up to 6), plus recent observations. Unconfirmed speech is not treated as delivered.
sessionMemoryClear: Clear this session and start again
sessionMemoryConfirm: This stops the current reply and clears all characters' live chat, short-term memory, and pending thoughts. Character cards, voice settings, and manual backups stay.
title: Little Whale · Live room

director.title: Director handbook and information
director.intro: Tell her what to improve during the stream. She records the feedback with its context. Review, edit, or remove it here.
director.connection_web: Public search and pages · Exa MCP
director.queryPolicy: The director can make up to 3 lookups per turn. Search requests send only search terms or a URL. Local context results are used by the director model. New speech or stop cancels old lookups. The anonymous Exa service may rate limit requests.
director.persisted: Feedback is saved locally for this character. Persistent feedback survives restarts.
director.temporary: Storage is disabled. Feedback lasts only until the backend restarts.
director.learningOn: Learning is on. Only clear coaching from the host can update the handbook. Viewer messages and webpages cannot change it.
director.learningOff: Learning is paused. Existing feedback still applies.
director.conflict: The handbook changed. Your draft is still here. Copy any text you need, cancel, and edit the latest entry.
director.empty: No feedback yet. Tell her what to adjust during the stream.

stickerUnavailable: This sticker is unavailable in the current AIRI library.
characterSyncFailed: Character settings could not be synced. Your message was not sent. Check the local connection and try again.
preparingVoice: Starting local voice. The first start takes longer…
requestTimeout: The service timed out. Your input is saved. Check the chat before you retry.
empty: Type as the host or a viewer, or start the microphone.
offline: Cannot connect to the local service. Run the desktop launcher.
token: Cohost access token (not a model key)
configNote: Appearance, rendering, themes, and stickers use AIRI settings. View effective model, voice, and recognition settings on their module pages.
decisionError: The request or response parsing failed. Please say that again.
decisionTimeout: The model request timed out. Please say that again.
input_recognizing: Recognizing speech. Continuing keeps the previous sentence.
input_empty: No text recognized. Please say another sentence.
input_short: That sound was too short. Please say a full sentence.
inputIssue_recognition: Recognition failed. Check the network. The microphone remains active.
inputIssue_connection: Capture feedback did not reach the local service. Check the local connection.
inputIssue_detection: Speech detection failed. Stop and restart the microphone.
inputIssue_device: The microphone disconnected. Check the system device, then restart capture.
inputIssue_backlog: Recognition is backed up. Pause, then restart the microphone.
inputQuiet: Recent volume is low. If you are speaking, check the system microphone and input level.
speechFailed: Speech generation or playback failed before completion
failed: Reply failed. Check the network and local settings.
tip: Ctrl + Enter to send · Viewer comments are simulated
voiceTip: Use headphones. Collapsing the panel keeps the microphone active.
biliMissing: Complete local setup. You can use blivechat without your own developer application.
biliLocalRelay: Source: local blivechat. Connected confirms the relay channel; incoming chat confirms room delivery.
biliError_configuration: Local connection settings are incomplete. Open chat setup.
biliError_credentials: Authentication was rejected. Check the anchor code or developer credentials.
biliError_platform: Chat service rejected the request. Check access, the anchor code or connection limits.
biliError_network: Cannot reach chat service. In local mode, make sure blivechat is running.
biliError_rate_limit: Bilibili rate limit reached. Try again later.
biliError_protocol: Unsupported data received. The connection has stopped.
biliError_timeout: Bilibili connection or heartbeat timed out.
speechSettingTip: These settings control live cohost speech and stay on this PC. Aqua uses a test reference until you provide clean dialogue.
speechPreparing: Preparing speech. The model loads on first use…
settingsOwnership: Cards, response models, and speech use the local configuration. Edit them through AIRI pages. Credentials stay in the local .env file.
cardBound: Live replies follow the saved active card from the next turn.
cardUnbound: Live replies still use the original whale persona. Migrate it or adopt the selected card.
cardApplied: The active card is synced to the live room.
cardPending: Waiting for the stage. Keep the live window open.
useCurrentCard: Use active card for live replies
emptyCard: Add a persona to the card first.
speechUnified: Chat and preview use these settings. The local service shares them across desktop and web.
speechSaved: Saved. The next response uses this voice.
speechStored: Saved on this computer. Desktop and web share these settings. Restarting or clearing the session keeps them.
speechTemporary: This is a temporary runtime. Restarting does not keep voice settings.
speechApply: After saving, the next response and preview use these settings. Wait for speech to finish before changing them.
speechPreviewStage: Playing in the {stage} main window. You can stop playback.
speechReference: Uses the reference voice configured on this computer.
speechNoEmotion: This adapter has no separate emotion controls.
continuityTitle: Session summary and things to revisit
summaryPolicy: An idle task selects excerpts from recent conversation blocks. Quotes can be shortened. Speaker and time stay attached. Viewer statements remain claims. No extra model calls.
summaryEmpty: No summary yet. New conversation is summarized when idle.
continuationPolicy: Up to 4 items, valid for 2 hours. Reconsider only with new conversation. Resumed means the reply was delivered, not that a task was completed.
continuationOldTopic: From an earlier topic. Wait for the host to return to it.
servicesUnified: These are the services used by the live cohost. Desktop and web share them.
serviceStored: Saved on this computer. Restarting or clearing the session keeps these settings.
serviceKeyMissing: Add the service credential to the local .env file, then restart the backend.
inferenceApply: The director and replies share this model and character. Saving checks model access. Changes apply to the next turn.
serviceConflict: Another window changed the configuration. Your draft is kept. Reload before editing again.
serviceSaved: Saved. Applies to the next turn.
recognitionApply: Stop capture before changing recognition. Save, then restart capture. The microphone follows the system by default. Voice and emotion settings stay unchanged.
localRecognitionReady: The local model loads when capture starts and unloads when capture stops.
localRecognitionMissing: Install the local recognition model before use.
recognitionTest: Return to the live panel and start capture. Watch the level meter and say a sentence. This page does not start another recognition session.
cardRepository: Cards and the active selection are saved by the local runtime. Use the native editor. Stale drafts cannot silently overwrite them.
cardReload: Back up draft and load saved cards
cardServiceScope: Live response models and voices use the shared settings pages. Native module overrides stay in the card for native AIRI mode.
hostingReason_idle: Leaving room for a response and choosing when to speak.
hostingReason_observing: Observing time and the room, then choosing whether to speak.
hostingReason_retry: The decision or playback failed. Review again shortly. Repeated failures pause hosting.
hostingTopic: Optional direction (leave blank for her choice)
hostingHint: Ask her to keep hosting while you are away. She observes time and the room, then chooses whether to speak. After stopping, ask her to continue.
hostingReason_manual: Autonomy is paused. Resume to continue.
hostingReason_control: A control changed the scene. Autonomy is paused.
hostingReason_stop: Stop received. Resume explicitly to restore autonomy.
hostingReason_stage: Stage audio disconnected. Reconnect before resuming.
hostingReason_muted: Responses are paused. Enable responses before resuming autonomy.
hostingReason_interrupted: The turn did not finish playing. Autonomy is paused.
hostingReason_error: The model decision failed. Resume to retry.
hostingReason_decision: She chose to wait for new input. No review is scheduled.
hostingReason_limit: This segment reached its runtime limit. Send new input or start another segment.
hostingReason_character: The character changed. Resume when ready.
hostingReason_scheduled: She scheduled another review. She can speak or stay quiet at that time.
